title: Ty Simpson, a top 15 pick? Why? One-year QB wonders don't work in NFL

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Ty Simpson, a top 15 pick? Why? One-year QB wonders don't work in NFL
sources.description: It's NFL Draft 101: Don't pick a one-year starter at quarterback in the first round. But Alabama's Ty Simpson is too enticing for some scouts.
